system.description:
A pack containing a compact tent, a water filter, and a lighter to start fires. The Tech Level 3 version adds thermal filaments to the tent to maintain a comfortable temperature, a more advanced water filtration system, and an electric heater/cooker as an alternative to a campfire.

The Survival Kit reduces the Difficulty of any Skill Test to find shelter in the wilderness by 1. A Tech Level 3 Survival Kit is also a powered item which recharges after a Break rest.
